title: Social Welfare Function Leaderboard: When LLM Agents Allocate Social Welfare

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating a long-horizon resource allocation scenario where an LLM acts as a sovereign allocator distributing tasks to recipient agents, and measuring the trade-off between collective efficiency (Return on Investment) and distributive fairness (Gini coefficient).

Calculating the correlation between task allocation counts and the recipient agents' initial capability labels (e.g., MMLU scores) compared to their actual runtime performance (ROI) to evaluate over-reliance on prestigious tags.
